method: bench/bench_gpu_gemm.mojo built against modified copies of the Q4_K kernel; Q6_K unchanged. GSM8K eval paused during each experiment; variants interleaved, two rounds each.

variants.noscale: epilogue keeps only Float32(c): no scale loads or FMAs
variants.intacc: int32 accumulation only: no conversion, no scales
variants.nomma: intacc, with the mma replaced by an xor of its operands
variants.nostage: intacc, weights and activations staged only for the first super-block
variants.v3: perf-gemm3: Q4_K packed nibbles in shared memory, 128 rows and 8 warps per block (Q6_K unchanged)

reading: Removing the scale epilogue saves about 40 ms and removing the mma 4 to 7 ms; removing staging saves about 120 ms (activations about 67, weights about 59). That staging is exposed rather than overlapped is an inference, not measured here.
